200.answer:
To activate your new SIM card for Bell Satellite TV, follow these steps:
- Remove the SIM card located behind a door on the front of the receiver, on the left side.
- Wait 15 seconds.
- Reinsert the SIM card with the arrow pointing upwards towards the receiver.
- Once the SIM card is reinserted, the receiver will restart and the programming should also restart.
